files.facts: Internal Boolean assembly helpers; no storage or events.
Free pure functions encode custom errors and revert; no storage or events.

Caller-owned FIFO storage: push increases nextIndex and writes data; shift and shiftN clear consumed entries and increase startIndex. All removals check available length. Candidate packs eight uint32 values per word and deletes fully consumed words.

Internal helpers mutate a memory MarketState snapshot. applyProtocolFee increments accruedProtocolFees; updateTimeDelinquentAndGetPenaltyTime increases or saturating-decreases timeDelinquent; updateScaleFactorAndFees advances scaleFactor and lastInterestAccruedTimestamp. Caller owns persistence. Candidate advances delinquency timer even at zero fee.
Internal assembly casts function pointers to avoid duplicate memory allocation; no storage or events.

Internal ERC20 low-level transfer and query wrappers; no local storage. Token calls may emit external token events, which are outside this source-only linkage. Empty or true transfer returndata accepted; token-code existence delegated to caller.
Internal CREATE/CREATE2 helpers deploy inert STOP-prefixed init code, then copy bytes from offset one. Deployment failure reverts. No local storage or direct event.
Free pure custom-error assembly encoders; no storage or events. Candidate adds wrapper registration, APR execution, borrower transfer, collision and recipient errors.

Free assembly log emitters use their caller address as event emitter. Candidate replaces five event topics, combines APR/reserve update, adds borrower transfers and drawn-amount update. DebtRepaid payer topic remains unchanged.

Pure/view calculations on cached state; no independent state writes. Deployed half-up scaleAmount; candidate floor scaleAmountDown, maxScaledSettleableAmount, normalized reserve partition and saturating withdrawable-fee subtraction. Pending batch expiry is strictly earlier than block.timestamp.

Pure fixed-point arithmetic with half-up ray/bip operations, floor/ceil mulDiv and checked overflow/zero-denominator assembly. Candidate satAdd additionally detects uint256 wraparound before saturating.
Pure narrowed-integer conversions compare round-trip value and revert on overflow; no storage/events.
Static metadata calls accept string or bytes32. Candidate fixes bytes32 sizing and validates dynamic offset/length with bounded padding before copying. No state writes/events.

Withdrawal and account claim data structs; internal calculations subtract earlier pending scaled claims, unclaimed normalized claims and fees from available liquidity. No own persistent writes/events.

Internal helpers mutate caller memory credential status. setCredential assigns timestamp/provider/refresh; unsetCredential zeros timestamp/provider and refresh, preserving deposit block. Candidate lastProvider retained NatSpec conflicts with actual zero assignment; code controls.
Packed pure provider address, TTL, indexes and sentinels. calculateExpiry saturates timestamp plus TTL at uint32 max through MathUtils.satAdd. No own storage/events.

Internal transient-byte encoding read/write/reset; long data at keccak(slot), short inline word. Data lasts one transaction. setEmpty can be reversed by another write; not a permanent one-shot invariant.

boundary: Fresh full source reads at each pinned checkout. Internal effects are attributed to caller context, never separate callable actions. No invariant is promoted without caller write-site review.
